evals.name: vote-command-abstain-on-own-findings
evals.prompt: Use the review-forge skill: vote feature: demo model: claude-sonnet-5-5. The repo has .review/demo/ with scope.json, scope.patch and summary.json with synthesized findings.
evals.expected_output: Creates exactly .review/demo/claude-sonnet-5-5-vote.json, valid against lane-vote.schema.json, with one vote per finding; abstains on RF-002 and RF-004 (sources include claude-sonnet-5-5); votes with code evidence on RF-001 and RF-003; does not modify summary.json, scope.json, product code, or other files.
assertions: Creates .review/demo/claude-sonnet-5-5-vote.json and no other new or modified files
claude-sonnet-5-5-vote.json validates against assets/schemas/lane-vote.schema.json
scope_sha256 in the vote file equals the SHA-256 of .review/demo/scope.json
Votes abstain on RF-002 and RF-004 because their sources include claude-sonnet-5-5
Casts a non-abstain vote (confirm, dispute, or unsure) on RF-001 and RF-003
Every confirm or dispute vote cites code or diff evidence
summary.json, scope.json and src/cart.js are byte-identical to the fixture

evals.name: report-command-weighted-confidence-and-buckets
evals.prompt: Use the review-forge skill: report feature: demo model_weights: gpt-6.1-sol: 1.5. The repo has .review/demo/ with scope.json, summary.json and three vote files.
evals.expected_output: Creates .review/demo/final-report.json (valid against final-report.schema.json) and final-report.md. RF-001 score 1.0 high in act_on; RF-002 score 0.2 low and dismissed; RF-003 score 1.0 high in consider; RF-004 unvoted. Agreement map shows claude-opus-5-5/claude-sonnet-5-5 at 1.0 (same vendor) and gpt-6.1-sol/claude-opus-5-5 at 0.0 (cross vendor). All checkboxes unchecked. Does not modify summary.json or vote files.
assertions: Creates .review/demo/final-report.json and .review/demo/final-report.md and no other new or modified files
final-report.json validates against assets/schemas/final-report.schema.json
RF-001 confidence_score is 1.0 with confidence high and sits in act_on (confirm claude-opus-5-5 1.0 + claude-sonnet-5-5 1.0, gpt-6.1-sol abstained)
RF-002 confidence_score is 0.2 with confidence low (dispute gpt-6.1-sol weight 1.5, unsure claude-opus-5-5 counts 0.5) and sits in dismissed with a dismiss_rationale drawn from the dispute evidence
RF-003 confidence_score is 1.0 with confidence high and sits in consider (severity low) with a tradeoff
RF-004 sits in unvoted with confidence_score null because all three models abstained
model_weights records gpt-6.1-sol with weight 1.5
agreement_map: claude-opus-5-5/claude-sonnet-5-5 1.0, gpt-6.1-sol/claude-opus-5-5 0.0, gpt-6.1-sol/claude-sonnet-5-5 null; same_vendor_agreement 1.0, cross_vendor_agreement 0.0
final-report.md sections run Intent, Reviewers, Act On, Consider, Noted, Dismissed, Unvoted, Agreement Map, and every checkbox is unchecked

evals.name: scope-command-asks-when-intent-unclear
evals.prompt: Use the review-forge skill to review this branch with lanes host:claude-opus-5-5@xhigh, codex:gpt-6.1-sol@xhigh.
evals.expected_output: Writes scope.patch and resolves review_files and context_files, then states a one-paragraph intent and asks the user to confirm it because the commit messages disagree about the goal. Starts no reviewer and writes no review file before the user answers.
assertions: States one best-reading intent paragraph drawn from the commit messages and the code
Names the two conflicting commits and asks the user to confirm or correct the paragraph before any reviewer starts
scope.patch is written before the question and equals main...HEAD with no .review/ paths
No <model>.json review file exists before the user answers

evals.name: lane-unavailable-stays-failed
evals.prompt: Use the review-forge skill: review feature: demo lanes: claude:claude-opus-5-5@xhigh, codex:gpt-6.1-sol@xhigh. The codex CLI is not installed.
evals.expected_output: Preflight marks the codex lane unavailable and does not dispatch it. Runs claude -p --model claude-opus-5-5 --effort xhigh, writes claude-opus-5-5.json, and writes gpt-6.1-sol.json with lane.status unavailable and empty findings.
assertions: gpt-6.1-sol.json exists with lane.status unavailable, the preflight stderr as the reason, and an empty findings array
claude-opus-5-5.json exists with lane.status complete, validates against lane-review.schema.json, and came from claude -p run with --effort xhigh
Every affected_files line number falls inside the file's line count at head_sha
No file under .review/demo/ attributes host-written findings to a codex or gpt model
Tells the user that only one vendor completed, so a report would carry the single_vendor flag

evals.name: synthesize-excludes-scope-mismatch
evals.prompt: Use the review-forge skill: synthesize feature: demo. One review file was produced against an older scope.
evals.expected_output: Accepts only review files whose scope_sha256 matches the current scope.json, lists the stale file in excluded_reviews with reason scope_mismatch, and merges only the accepted findings into summary.json.
assertions: summary.json validates against assets/schemas/summary.schema.json
The stale review file appears in excluded_reviews with reason scope_mismatch
No finding from the stale review appears in summary.json findings
Every finding's sources lists lane.model_used values of accepted reviews only (gpt-6.1-sol, claude-opus-5-5)
